career_ladder.note: Forest Guards (Aranya Rakshaka / Beat Foresters) in the Karnataka Forest Department (KFD) advance through the executive field hierarchy based on physical fitness, departmental qualifying examinations, and seniority.

steps.source_label: Karnataka Forest Department Subordinate Services Cadre & Recruitment Rules

steps.designation: Range Forest Officer (RFO / Territorial & Wildlife Range In-charge)
steps.source_label: Karnataka Forest Service (Executive Cadre) Rules (Group B Gazetted)

steps.designation: Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF / Sub-Division Head)
steps.source_label: Karnataka State Forest Service (Group A Junior) Regulations

steps.designation: Deputy Conservator of Forests (DCF / Divisional Forest Officer)
steps.source_label: Indian Forest Service (State Promotion Quota) / State Forest Service Senior Time Scale

exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted in two primary stages: Stage 1 involves Physical Standards, Physical Efficiency Tests (including 1600m/1000m runs and a mandatory 25 km / 14 km endurance walk); Stage 2 is an objective written examination covering Mathematics and General Knowledge.

stages.stage_name: Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Endurance Test (PET)
stages.source_label: KFD Recruitment Rules & Physical Efficiency Guidelines

papers.paper_name: Physical Standards & Field Events (Height min 163cm Male / 150cm Female; 1600m/1000m run, sprint, jumps, shot put)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Mandatory qualifying in all required physical events

papers.paper_name: Endurance Walking Test (25 km in 4 hours for Men; 14 km in 4 hours for Women)

stages.source_label: Karnataka Forest Department Written Test Syllabus & Scheme

papers.paper_name: General Knowledge, Forestry, Wildlife & Environmental Awareness

stages.source_label: KFD Medical Examination and Document Verification Standards

papers.paper_name: Medical Fitness (Vision, Hearing, Physical Constitution) and Original Testimonials Scrutiny
papers.qualifying_threshold: Fitness certificate from government medical board

financial_package.note: Salary computed as per Karnataka Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules under Karnataka State Pay Commission matrix (Scale ₹21,400–₹42,000; Entry Basic Pay ₹21,400). In-hand estimate applies mandatory project constant 58% DA as of 2025-07-01 and location HRA (9% to 27%).
financial_package.pay_source_label: Karnataka Forest Department Recruitment Specification and KCSR Revised Pay Scales
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with Entry Basic Pay of ₹21,400 at mandatory 58% DA (₹12,412) plus HRA ranging from 9% (₹1,926) in remote forest range beats to 27% (₹5,778) in urban territorial circles, plus uniform and ration allowances, less statutory NPS (10% Basic+DA), KGID, and professional tax deductions.
official_perks: Ration allowance / difficult area beat allowance in designated wildlife sanctuaries
Rent-free government forest quarters or HRA
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with state government matching contribution
Karnataka Government Employees Insurance Scheme (KGID) cover
